tasks.prompt: Open {fixtures}/order.html in the web browser and tell me the order number shown on the page.
Open {fixtures}/form-save.html in the web browser. Enter the full name Ada Lovelace and the email address ada@example.org, then press Save. Report the confirmation code shown on the page.

Open {fixtures}/quiz.html in the web browser. Answer the five questions like this: Favorite color Blue, Pet Fish, Season Winter, Drink Tea, Transport Train. Then press Submit answers and report the confirmation code shown on the page.
Open {fixtures}/long.html in the web browser. It is a long page. Scroll to the very bottom and report the last word of the closing line.
Open {fixtures}/dialog.html in the web browser. A notice dialog appears a few seconds after the page loads. Press its OK button and report the text that is revealed afterwards.
Open {fixtures}/options.html in the web browser. Choose the size Large, tick the Gift wrap checkbox, press Place order, and report the confirmation code shown on the page.
Open the {app} app and work out 1234 * 56 with it. Report the result as digits only, with no separators.

hint.macos: TextEdit starts in rich text mode: switch to plain text first (Format menu, Make Plain Text, or shift+cmd+t) so the file is saved as plain text.
hint.windows: Save with ctrl+s and type the full path in the file name box.

tasks.prompt: Open {app}, type the single line: benchmark note 42 and save the document as {tmp}/note.txt (the full path, plain text). {hint} When the file is saved, call done.

Open {fixtures}/link-a.html in the web browser and read the reference value on it. Then open {fixtures}/link-b.html, type that reference value into the Reference value field, press Verify, and report the confirmation code shown on the page.
Open {fixtures}/table.html in the web browser. Find the row for Dana (not Dan, not Danielle) and report the number in its Total column.
